issue.title: set_speed inaccurate with floating point (nanosecond) datetime values results in unmitigatable error

summary.text: The verifier reproduced the bug with a test that fails before the fix and passes after it, and showed the tests fail again when the fix is reverted or broken, with no regressions found. The behaviour comparison did not finish for Trajectory._get_df_with_distance, _get_df_with_acceleration, add_distance and add_acceleration, so check those paths with nanosecond-precision timestamps next.
